diagram_previews.alt: Oblique sketch of regular tetrahedron ABCD with front edges AB (labelled 6), AD and BD solid and the hidden edges to C dashed. The red centre O of the inscribed sphere is joined to the four vertices by blue dashed segments, and a red segment r drops from O to the centre of face ABC.
